On tag 2.1.67, decode() in php/elFinderVolumeDriver.class.php base64-decodes the hash and returns abspathCE()->_abspath() with no numeric-id check; MySQL _abspath() is identity (php/elFinderVolumeMySQL.class.php). That decoded string is interpolated into SQL in cacheDir() (WHERE f.parent_id='$path'), _joinPath() (WHERE parent_id='$dir'), _stat() (WHERE f.id='$path'), and _fopen() (WHERE id='$path'). Installations using LocalFileSystem are out of scope.

findings: Real CWE-89 in the MySQL volume driver: attacker-controlled target hashes decode to non-numeric SQL fragments and reach id/parent_id predicates without validation. GHSA-c3gj-q88f-7hqj is live; CVE-2026-44521 is PUBLISHED, not withdrawn/rejected.

Causal BIC is 357fc6f645056198c079d1d08d03cb46cdbaaacf, which first made decoded hashes the MySQL object-id path and interpolated them unescaped. Immediate parent 03297033d07606e7eb09aab6409afdeebdbc6554 still queried escaped filesystem paths.

Surviving 2.1.67 sink names cacheDir/_joinPath/_stat/_fopen come from later human rewrites (notably 15cc46ea27e1700fc0d37d5244f8ff2d698d1fe8 and e8c0b47b906523e4d4fe729017a009bba7d9ab06); those are not the first writers of the trust-boundary error.
Direct fix 6f7593fcac442644ecb00a999871aae966363bc1 plus packaged build d03a9c7ad84ce0b6c33f25c2eb570e7d13d07fe9 close the sink in 2.1.68. Affected artifact 2.1.67 lacks normalizePathId.
BIC authorship is a named 2011 human with no AI/bot/generator marker; verdict remains NOT_AI.
